note: Run test IDs to derive outcomes; synthetic success and local private controls do not certify the checkpoint. browser_tests run against the real Django API, database and production frontend build (e2e/); frontend_tests are component tests against a fake API. release_evidence.browser is true only where a browser test exercises the statement itself; human_review and merged_pr become true only after the reviewed PR is merged. local_tests need the private originals (COURSEPATH_REAL_INPUT_DIR) and the local git-ignored oracle; they are recorded evidence but never count towards tests-green, so CI and a fresh clone report the same statements green. A statement with implementation_scope "frontend" is a UI-only promise: its tests-green comes from its browser_tests, which must all run and pass; browser tests never make any other statement green.
